Frame critique: on `released`, `Button` on `Buttons, Menus & Toolbars` and `Hosting a class component` on `Functional Components` stood out as lone dark-stage tiles against light neighbours in Neo Light, `Hosting a class component` showed the pre-`#21946` hard-coded blue button on Neo Dark, and `Dialogs & Overlays` rendered `"component.Toast"` and `"plugin.Popover"` (independently flagged by both blinded readers in `#22019`'s `## Cold look`). On `changed`, all four `Buttons` tiles and all three `Functional Components` tiles match the active Portal scheme cleanly across `1440×900` and `390×844` with readable white-on-black `"Badge"` text, and all four `Dialogs & Overlays` cards carry visitor-facing titles (`"Contact Editor Dialogs"`, `"Toast Notifications"`, `"Popover"`, `"Tooltips"`). Demonstration cards without light covers (`toast`, `popover`, `live-preview`, `email`, `context-menu-files`, `toolbar-application`, `grid-server-side`) remain tracked on `#21942`.
